lines.en: : I’m telling you, it was an accident! If I had known that was Ami, of course I wouldn’t have used my tongue!
lines.zh: ：我跟你说了，那是个意外！要是我知道那是 Ami，我当然不会用舌头！

lines.en: : Maya, I understand that you are in love with me, but you really need to ask permission before doing that sort of thing.
lines.zh: ：Maya，我理解你爱上了我，但做那种事之前你真得先征求同意。

lines.en: : Maybe she tried and you just didn’t hear her because of where your tongues were?
lines.zh: ：也许她试过了，只是你们舌头所在的位置让她没法被听见？

lines.en: : Why are neither of you listening to me?! I’m telling you that’s not what happened! I seriously had no idea!
lines.zh: ：你们两个为什么都不听我说？！我跟你说了不是那样的！我真的不知道！

lines.en: : Well, I’m sorry Maya but it’s just really hard to believe you didn’t know when we literally talked about it beforehand.
lines.zh: ：这个嘛，抱歉 Maya，可我们事先明明聊过这事，说你不知道实在很难让人相信。

lines.en: : Yeah, this just sounds like an excuse to me. But if you’re worried about getting too carried away, don’t be.
lines.zh: ：是啊，这听起来对我就是个借口。不过你要是担心自己太失控，别担心。

lines.en: : At least you got permission. That’s one whole step ahead of Molly and you both kissed the same amount of girls tonight.
lines.zh: ：至少你拿到同意了。这就比 Molly 领先整整一步，而你们今晚亲的女孩数量一样多。

lines.en: : Oh my fucking- {i}no!{/i} You’re not listening to me!
lines.zh: ：我他妈的——{i}不{/i}！你们没在听我说！

lines.en: : Something’s going on! I’m...I’m not myself.
lines.zh: ：有事在发生！我……我不是我自己了。

lines.en: : Of course you are, Maya! It doesn’t matter to either one of us which gender you prefer. You’ll always be {i}Maya{/i} to us.
lines.zh: ：你当然是你啊，{i}Maya{/i}！你更喜欢哪个性别对我们俩都无所谓。你永远是我们的 Maya。

lines.en: : You have roughly thirty seconds left to live.
lines.zh: ：你大概还剩三十秒可活。

lines.en: : Maya, stop. Making threats isn’t going to change anything. But I don’t want to make a big deal out of this so let’s just chalk it up to a...misunderstanding and agree to not speak about it anymore.
lines.zh: ：Maya，停下。威胁改变不了任何事。但我不想把这事闹大，所以我们就把它当成一场……误会，说好不再提了。

lines.en: : Fine! Okay! Whatever! That still doesn’t change the fact that something is seriously wrong with me all of a sudden!
lines.zh: ：行！好！随便！那也改变不了我突然真的出了什么问题这个事实！
：还有——

lines.en: : Twenty seconds, Ayane. Don’t even think about making another joke.
lines.zh: ：二十秒，Ayane。别再想着开玩笑。

lines.en: : What do you mean by “something is wrong” though? We still have no clue what that means.
lines.zh: ：可你说「出了什么问题」到底是什么意思？我们还是不知道那指什么。

lines.en: : Yeah, the timeline for us has been: Maya and Ami kiss, Maya uses tongue, Ami screams, we all leave the room. At what point did something go wrong?
lines.zh: ：是啊，我们的时间线是这样的：Maya 和 Ami 接吻，Maya 用了舌头，Ami 尖叫，我们全都离开房间。到底是哪个环节出了问题？

lines.en: : {i}Before{/i} that! Do you want to hear my timeline? Halloween. Different Halloween. Makeout session with Ami’s uncle. Makeout session with Ami. Who’s next? Fucking Noriko?
lines.zh: ：在那{i}之前{/i}！你想听听我的时间线吗？万圣节。另一个万圣节。和 Ami 的舅舅亲热。和 Ami 亲热。下一个是谁？跟他妈 Noriko？
：啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊！！

lines.en: : Just go along with it. She’s clearly having some sort of episode right now.
lines.zh: ：顺着她就是了。她显然正在发作什么。

lines.en: : I’m not having a fucking episode! The world is clearly breaking and no one seems to be aware of it but me!
lines.zh: ：我没有他妈在发作！世界显然正在崩坏，而除了我好像没人察觉到！

lines.en: : It’s like every five minutes I’m getting sent to a different place in time!
lines.zh: ：就像每隔五分钟我就被送到时间里的另一个地方！

lines.en: : So what’s to stop me from making out with literally {i}everyone{/i} if it’s just going to be erased in a little while?!
lines.zh: ：所以如果反正一会儿就会被抹掉，那我为什么不能干脆把{i}所有人{/i}都亲一遍？！

lines.en: : I’ll go next if it’ll make you feel better. I’m not really into girls, but I won’t lie in saying that I’m feeling kind of left out that your feelings for Ami are so much stronger than your feelings for me.
lines.zh: ：如果能让你好受点，我下一个来。我对女生其实没兴趣，但我不否认我有点被排除在外——你对 Ami 的感觉比对我的强太多了。

lines.en: : It was rhetorical, Ayane! I’m not actually going to do that!
lines.zh: ：那是反讽，Ayane！我又不是真要做！

lines.en: : Just like you {i}weren’t{/i} going to use your tongue on Ami, right?
lines.zh: ：就像你本来{i}没打算{/i}对 Ami 用舌头一样，对吧？

lines.en: : Ayane, shush. Maya, if something’s actually wrong, shouldn’t you lie down? There’s gotta be some kind of infirmary thingy here, right?
lines.zh: ：Ayane，别说了。Maya，如果真有哪里不对，你不是该躺下吗？这儿总该有什么医务室之类的东西吧？

lines.en: : That’s exactly how this whole thing started, Ami! You and me were hanging out. {i}Then{/i} we were somewhere else.
lines.zh: ：这事就是从这儿开始的，Ami！你和我在一起待着。{i}然后{/i}我们就到了别的地方。

lines.en: : So {i}you{/i} said we should lie down in Ayane’s weird hospital room thing. And I agreed. Then I brought up the threesome and you told Molly to get drunk. After that, it’s been like 90%% kissing. I’m going insane!
lines.zh: ：然后{i}你{/i}说我们该去 Ayane 那个奇怪的病房似的地方躺下。我同意了。接着我提了三人行，你让 Molly 去喝个烂醉。那之后，大概 90%% 都是在接吻。我要疯了！

lines.en: : You sure are. I don’t even know what threesome you’re talking about.
lines.zh: ：你确实疯了。我连你说的三人行是什么都不知道。

lines.en: : You, me, and Sensei! It was {i}your{/i} idea!
lines.zh: ：你、我，还有 Sensei！那是{i}你自己{/i}的主意！

lines.en: : Why do you guys keep leaving me out of stuff?! We can easily make it a foursome instead!
lines.zh: ：你们为什么老把我排除在外？！我们完全可以轻松搞成四人行！

lines.en: : Hey, can you guys maybe {i}not{/i} say stuff like that directly in front of Sensei? Thanks.
lines.zh: ：嘿，你们能不能{i}别{/i}当着 Sensei 的面直接说这种话？谢谢了。

lines.en: : Oh! Hi, Sensei. Now the games can really begin.
lines.zh: ：哦！嗨，Sensei。现在游戏才真正开始。

lines.en: : Sorry, what’s going on out here exactly? Because the rest of the girls are wondering when you’re all going to be going back in there for round two.
lines.zh: ：抱歉，外面到底在闹什么？因为其他女孩都在想知道你们什么时候回去打第二轮。

lines.en: : Sensei! Where were we just a minute ago?! You remember, right?
lines.zh: ：Sensei！我们一分钟之前在哪？你记得吧？
：那……酒店房间？
：在那之前，白痴！
：那……大堂？
：啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊！！！！！！

lines.en: : Don’t pay her any mind, Sensei. Maya’s decided to come up with some weird story about jumping through time because she’s embarrassed about getting too lesbian with Ami.
lines.zh: ：别理她，Sensei。Maya 因为跟 Ami 太百合了不好意思，就编了个穿越时间的怪故事。

lines.en: : No, Ayane. I think there’s something true about what Maya’s saying. Like, maybe not for us. But what if she actually {i}is{/i} part of some weird time-hopping thingy? What do we do to fix it?
lines.zh: ：不，Ayane。我觉得 Maya 说的{i}有{/i}几分是真的。比如说，也许不适用于我们。但要是她真的卷进了什么奇怪的时空跳跃里呢？我们该怎么补救？

lines.en: : Yes! Thank you, Ami! These are the questions we need to be asking! The next jump could happen any second now!
lines.zh: ：对！谢谢你，Ami！这才是我们该问的问题！下一次跳跃随时都可能发生！

lines.en: : Sorry, I’m confused again. Are you saying that the only reason you put your tongue in Ami’s mouth was because you were putting your tongue in {i}my{/i} mouth in an alternate timeline beforehand?
lines.zh: ：抱歉，我又糊涂了。你是说，你把舌头伸进 Ami 嘴里的唯一原因，是因为在另一条时间线里你正把舌头伸进{i}我{/i}嘴里？
：对！正是这样！

lines.en: : And you just...happened to teleport to another place in time where you were {i}also{/i} making out with someone?
lines.zh: ：而你就……碰巧传送到了另一个时间里，在那儿你{i}也{/i}在跟人亲热？

lines.en: : Oh, Maya. I had no idea you were this promiscuous...
lines.zh: ：哦，Maya。我没想到你这么随便……

lines.en: : I’m not promiscuous! It was like...kissing probably triggered it?!
lines.zh: ：我不随便！大概就是……接吻触发了它？！

lines.en: : Then why not try triggering it again?
lines.zh: ：那为什么不试着再触发一次？
：好主意。来吧。

lines.en: : Wait, with me? I meant that you should kiss one of the girls again. That was hot as hell. And you’re always calling me a creepy stalker anyway.
lines.zh: ：等等，跟我？我的意思是让你再亲其中一个女孩。那真是辣爆了。而且你反正总说我是变态跟踪狂。

lines.en: : Yeah, well there’s no more pressure on me to save face when you’ve already decided to dump me for your stupid childhood friend. I’m going all out now. And that involves making out with you in front of your niece.
lines.zh: ：是啊，既然你已经决定为了你那个蠢青梅竹马甩掉我，我也没什么面子好保了。我现在要全力开火。而这包括当着你侄女的面跟你亲热。

lines.en: : Yeah, I’d really prefer you didn’t do that.
lines.zh: ：是啊，我真的希望你别那么做。

lines.en: : Do you at least want to hide behind the excuse of spin the bottle? Because I’m pretty sure I’ve figured out a trick where I can just spin it really softly and have it land on whoever I-
lines.zh: ：你至少要不要借转瓶子的借口遮掩一下？因为我挺确定我琢磨出了个招，能把它轻轻一转就让它停在我想要的任何人——
：你的嘴。我的嘴。现在。

lines.en: : Somebody help! Maya’s going on a kissing rampage and blaming it all on time!
lines.zh: ：来人啊！Maya 开始到处亲人了，还把一切都怪到时间上！

lines.en: : And what’s even worse is she’s leaving me out of it!
lines.zh: ：更糟的是她还把我排除在外！
：请……记录在案……
：我……与这一切……无关……
：这……全是她……

lines.en: : Wait, hold on. Does anyone else hear-
lines.zh: ：等等，等一下。还有别人听见——
：唔！唔嘞嗯……唔嗯呣！唔嗯嗯！

lines.en: Somewhere you’re not/somewhere you are\nSomewhere it’s close/somewhere it’s far
lines.zh:
你不在的某处／你在的某处
某处它很近／某处它很远

lines.en: That gash in your hands/the one on your leg\nIt matches my eyes/that same shade of red
lines.zh:
你手上的那道口子／你腿上的那道
它和我的眼睛同色／那是同一种红

lines.en: So why do you run?/Why do you hide?\nIf the memories fade/why not keep them inside?
lines.zh:
那你为何奔逃？／为何躲藏？
若记忆终将褪色／何不把它们留在心里？

lines.en: I’ve always been here/You’re never alone\nOur love is a house/We can make it a home
lines.zh:
我一直都在这里／你从不孤单
我们的爱是一座房子／我们可以把它变成家

lines.en: A room for your pain/a room for your doubt\nA room for your sister/A place to black out
lines.zh:
一间给你的痛／一间给你的疑
一间给你的妹妹／一个断电昏厥的地方

lines.en: If death is a lake/we’ll dive in as one\nOur feet touch the sand/Our hearts touch the sun
lines.zh:
若死亡是一片湖／我们就一同跃入
我们的脚触到沙／我们的心触到太阳

lines.en: Remember the smell/Remember the light\nRemember to smile/Remember I might
lines.zh:
记住那气味／记住那光
记得要微笑／记得我也许

lines.en: But only if you can/forget everything\nIf you promise me that/I’ll repair these old wings
lines.zh:
但前提是你能／忘掉一切
你若答应我这一点／我就修好这些旧翅膀

lines.en: And we’ll fly off together to a place no one can reach us.
lines.zh: 然后我们就一起飞走，去一个谁也够不到我们的地方。

lines.en: {b}THIS IS SUPPOSED TO BE MY STORY{/b}
lines.zh: {b}这本该是我的故事{/b}

lines.en: The girl with the me who is me who is Ami I am Ami {b}CAN YOU HEAR ME?{/b}
lines.zh: 那个带有我 我就是我 我就是 Ami 我是 Ami 的女孩 {b}你能听见我吗{/b}？
：等等……停下。
：我们不能。
：你只是……
：我们不该。
：搞什么……
：……Maya？
：今天几号？……

lines.en: : Uhh...a few days after Christmas I think? I haven’t really been keeping track.
lines.zh: ：呃……我想是圣诞节过后几天？我没怎么在记日子。

lines.en: : And how long have I been here?
lines.zh: ：那我在这里多久了？

lines.en: : I’m...not really sure when the last time you left is. What’s gotten into you?
lines.zh: ：我……不太确定你上次离开是什么时候。你怎么了？
：没什么，我只是……
：今天……挺怪的。
但我在这里很开心……

lines.en: : And if the world ends right now, I won’t care.
lines.zh: 如果世界现在终结，我也不会在意。
这台词不错。

lines.en: : I’ve been keeping it in my back pocket while waiting for a special moment. I figure this’ll be the best I get.
lines.zh: 我一直把它揣在兜里，等着一个特别的时刻。我估计这就是我能得到的最好的了。

lines.en: : You can keep going, you know. You don’t have to hold back for my sake.
lines.zh: 你可以继续说下去，你知道的。你不必为了我而克制。
我爱你，Akira。

lines.en: : No. No, you can’t say that. That’s enough for today.
lines.zh: 不。不，你不能这么说。今天到此为止。

lines.en: : Huh?! Why?! I don’t want this to be over yet. I just got here!
lines.zh: 欸？！为什么？！我还不想结束。我才刚到这里！

lines.en: : Yeah, but things have already gone way too far. And I can’t...I can’t say those words back to you. Not the way I am now. Probably never.
lines.zh: 是啊，但事情已经走得太远了。而我不能……我不能用现在这个样子对你说出那些话。大概永远都不能。

lines.en: : I’m sorry...We should just...We should end this before we let it go any further.
lines.zh: 对不起……我们就……我们该在它走得更远之前结束这一切。

lines.en: : Is this...really how it went back then?...
lines.zh: 这……当时真的是这样发展的吗？……

lines.en: : How what went? What are you talking about?
lines.zh: 什么怎么样？你在说什么？

lines.en: : Do you...mind if I sound a little crazy for a second?
lines.zh: 你……介意我疯一下吗？
完全不介意……请说吧。

lines.en: : I’ve spent the last hour or two swimming through a montage of nonsense. Multiple seasons. Multiple holidays. I even kissed your niece.
lines.zh: 我刚才那一个来小时都在一堆胡言乱语里游来游去。好几个季节。好几个节日。我甚至亲了你的侄女。

lines.en: : Wait, how do you even know about-
lines.zh: 等等，你怎么会知道——

lines.en: : Just shut the fuck up, okay? I’m not the Maya who was here a second ago. I’m a new one — the result of what {i}this{/i} turns into. And it might...suck sometimes, yeah. But I still wouldn’t trade it for the world.
lines.zh: 你给我闭嘴，行吗？我不是一秒前在这儿的那个 Maya。我是个新的——是{i}这一切{/i}演变出的结果。它有时候……确实会很糟。但我还是不会拿它换全世界。

lines.en: : Does that make you a deplorable, terrible person? Yes. But you’re {i}my{/i} deplorable, terrible person. And I need you to be that way, because {i}you{/i} being utterly despicable is what keeps me grounded.
lines.zh: 这让你成了一个卑劣、糟糕的人吗？是的。但你是{i}我的{/i}卑劣、糟糕的人。而你需要那样，因为正是{i}你{/i}那份彻底的卑劣让我稳住了脚跟。
Maya——

lines.en: : Never leave me. Ever. Ever. Ever. Ever. Ever. Ever. Ever. And I promise you — I will do the same.
lines.zh: 永远别离开我。永远。永远。永远。永远。永远。永远。我答应你——我也会一样。

lines.en: : This is way more than just “a little crazy.” You know that, right?
lines.zh: 这可不只是「疯一下」。你知道的吧？

lines.en: : Yeah. And if you said that like three teleportations ago, I would have agreed and shut the fuck up about it. But I have no idea when this is going to end and if these moments are going to impact anything.
lines.zh: 知道。要是你在三次传送之前说这话，我会同意，然后他妈的闭嘴不提。但我不知道这一切什么时候会结束，也不知道这些时刻会不会影响什么。
你到底在——

lines.en: : Years and years from now, when I’m older, you’re going to have doubts about me. Something’s going to happen and...you’ll fall out of love. Or maybe you won’t. I don’t...I don’t really get what happens yet.
lines.zh: 很多很多年之后，等我更大了，你会对我产生怀疑。有件事会发生，然后……你就不再爱我了。又或许不会。我……我还不大明白会发生什么。

lines.en: : But I never listened when you tried to tell me. And I’m sorry for that. I {i}should{/i} have listened.
lines.zh: 可你当初想告诉我时，我从来没有听。为此我很抱歉。我本{i}该{/i}听的。

lines.en: : Because now {i}I’m{/i} doing the same thing and...I’m so afraid of losing you that it’s not even funny.
lines.zh: 因为现在{i}我{/i}在做同样的事，而我……我太害怕失去你了，这一点都不好笑。

lines.en: : So I want you to say it right now. I want you to say that you love me. And I want you to promise me that {i}nothing-{/i} no childhood friend or...time itself will ever change that.
lines.zh: 所以我要你现在就说出来。我要你说你爱我。我要你答应我，{i}没有任何东西{/i}——没有什么青梅竹马，也没有……时间本身，能改变这一点。
还是太早了，Maya……

lines.en: : Bullshit! You know it’s true! What difference does a year or two make at this point?! Just fucking say it, okay?! I need to hear it at least one more time! Even if you’re lying! I can just tell myself you’re not!
lines.zh: 胡说！你知道那是真的！到这个地步，差一两年又有什么分别？！你就他妈的说了吧，行吗？！我需要再听至少一次！哪怕你在骗我也行！我自己骗自己说不是就好了！
该走了，Maya。

lines.en: : Don’t you fucking do this, Akira.
lines.zh: 你他妈别这样，Akira。

lines.en: : I’m not Akira. I’m not even here.
lines.zh: 我不是 Akira。我甚至不在这里。

lines.en: : No! Shut the fuck up! This one has to be real! I can’t handle much more of this!
lines.zh: 不！你他妈闭嘴！这一次必须是真的！我再也受不了了！

lines.en: : Aww...Well I’ve got {i}really{/i} bad news then! Because the worst is yet to come. Or maybe the best depending on how you look at it?
lines.zh: 哎呀……那我有{i}非常{/i}坏的消息要告诉你！因为最坏的还在后头。又或者是最好的，取决于你怎么看？
：哈……哈哈哈……

lines.en: : You made me use that great line for nothing, didn’t you?...
lines.zh: ：你让我白用了那句绝妙的台词，是吧？……

lines.en: : It was very impressive. But yes, I guess so.
lines.zh: ：非常精彩。不过，是的，大概是这样。
：你是谁啊？……
：我的良心？
：我肩上的恶魔？

lines.en: : Is this supposed to be some kind of “trial?”
lines.zh: ：这算是什么「试炼」吗？
：我{i}死{/i}了吗？
：如果不是，那我{i}是{/i}什么？
：也许你睡着了？

lines.en: : God, I fucking hope so. This has been the most immersive nightmare of my life if that’s the case.
lines.zh: ：老天，我他妈的希望如此。要真是那样，这就是我这辈子最沉浸式的一场噩梦。

lines.en: : Blah, blah, blah. You ready to “wake up” now?
lines.zh: ：巴拉巴拉巴拉。准备好「醒来」了吗？
：操你。
{b}你的愿望就是我的命令。{/b}
我现在明白了。
我在炼狱里。
Mayaaaaa？你醒了吗？
：……Ami？
